description: Triage a domain that disappeared from Google. Checks nine causes in crawl-then-index order (domain registration via RDAP, TLS certificate, robots.txt status, robots.txt rule for the homepage, homepage status as Googlebot vs a browser, redirects off the domain, noindex in meta or X-Robots-Tag, canonical to another host, sitemap served and parseable) and returns each as ruled_out, suspect, confirmed or unknown with evidence. Costs 6 fetches. Same check as https://stillindexed.com/tools/deindex-triage.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL, or a hostname (https is assumed).

name: stillindexed_deindex_triage
